agent.name: Emerging Technology Adoption Agent
agent.specialty: Contextual current adoption posture and evidence conditions

analytical_question: For the conservative financial-services case, what present adoption action is warranted over four weeks, with quarterly reconsideration?
general_et_finding: Agentic AI here means an integrated model, model-selected tools, observations, permissions and human stopping authority, not an isolated LLM or chart plugin. The supplied survey indicates some organizational agent scaling, but does not locate this specific workflow on a diffusion curve. On C1’s portfolio vocabulary, a provisional leading/experimental rather than commodity posture is plausible for this exact use, not established as a market fact. S2 warns that adaptability adds latency, expense and cascading-error paths; simpler deterministic checks remain a genuine alternative.
application_finding: Read-only examination of approved tables and chart claims followed by a correction draft can potentially locate wrong denominators, unsupported interpretations and missing source links. The agent’s possible advantage over manual analyst review and deterministic table/chart checks is unmeasured. A draft is retractable before human sign-off, but a convincing incorrect draft could still contaminate management reporting. Technical possibility does not establish comparative quality, speed, costs or readiness for routine review.
organization_specific_finding: The conservative firm has capable analysts and established BI data, but no approved external model environment, no approved agent trial setting and no agent-specific validation set. Public or synthetic material is permitted for desk research only; permission for this exercise cannot be inferred from another lab or TW6 contrast. Financial-services reporting raises consequences of hallucinated claims, denominator mistakes and unauthorized exposure. These constraints block an operating pilot even if the generic technology is promising. The conservative posture favors resolving an identifiable authorization gate rather than treating willingness to experiment as approval.

evidence.claim: Course framework distinguishes bleeding, leading, commodity and trailing positions, plus six conditional adoption actions.
evidence.source_or_reference: C1, ET 7 Classification and Adoption Strategie FA26, slides 10-29, 31, 45
evidence.notes: Classification is contextual, not an age-based certification.

evidence.claim: Prior team analysis identifies unknown exact-use diffusion and net benefit; permissions precede value comparisons.
evidence.source_or_reference: T1, Special Dark TW6 team diffusion package and record, B-C/G-H
evidence.notes: Neither independent market proof nor permission for this run.

evidence.claim: Respondents reported agents scaling in at least one function: 40% for organizations above $1bn revenue, 22% for smaller organizations.
evidence.source_or_reference: S1, McKinsey, The state of AI in 2026: On the road to ROI
evidence.notes: Not chart-review adoption or local ROI; the case firm’s revenue is unspecified.

evidence.claim: Simpler workflows may outperform more flexible agents on cost, latency and error propagation.
evidence.source_or_reference: S2, Anthropic, Building effective agents, When and when not to use agents
evidence.notes: Dated and not a measured comparison for this organization.

evidence.claim: Capability claims require empirical checks, traceable evidence and appropriate predeployment review.
evidence.notes: Not mandatory law, validation, or a safe-use certificate.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: S1 measures self-reported agent scaling across functions, not comparable chart-review deployments; firm revenue is unknown.
T1 is a classroom team judgment; neither measured local outcomes nor a sandbox authorization.
No matched chart-review peer cohort, pricing, qualified model/version, legal-jurisdiction specifics, cost estimate or local accuracy study is supplied.
S2 is dated vendor advice; S3 voluntary guidance is not a jurisdiction-specific rule.
confidence_and_uncertainty: High confidence in the documented permissions barrier and lack of comparative proof; moderate confidence that controlled testing could be useful if authorized; low confidence in any specific diffusion class, ROI or reliability claim. Nothing was deployed or tested.
value_opportunity_implication: Potential time savings and claim/source traceability are hypotheses only. Define the manual review and deterministic-check baselines, representative synthetic chart cases, error severity categories and evidence-capture requirements before a comparative decision. No reduction in review time may be assumed.
risk_governance_implication: Do not transmit sensitive reporting data to an unapproved model, connect live BI tools, or circulate agent-generated corrections as approved findings. A named human retains interpretive and publication authority. Security, model-risk and compliance permission issues should be handed to the Organizational Adoption Agent for readiness ownership, not converted here into an enterprise rollout plan.
recommendation_management_implication: Main action: DEFER the proposed agent trial and operating adoption pending a specific approved isolated test environment, project authority and permitted data scope. Defer is not rejection of the use case: over the four-week window, desk-review the evidence and seek the relevant approval decisions; use public/synthetic examples only for non-executing study. Once authorized, reconsider a bounded experiment comparing agent drafts to manual and deterministic checks, not production adoption. Monitor alone understates the resolvable permission block; proof of concept is premature without an authorized trial; Adopt and Bounded experiment now exceed permissions. Conservative management posture supports this gate-first decision.
change_monitoring_triggers: Written project approval and specified isolated, permissioned agent environment with synthetic-only or separately authorized data.
Named reviewer and stopping authority, source logging, error escalation and approved access boundaries.
Validated head-to-head evidence for claim accuracy, denominators, traceability, reviewer time and failure severity versus manual and deterministic alternatives.
Quarterly reconsideration during the twelve-month horizon if permissions, exact-use evidence or risk constraints change.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Cannot choose a model, establish local ROI, certify legal compliance or declare chart-agent diffusion/chasm position from these sources.
Request explicit trial approvals, evaluation cases, baselines, acceptable error thresholds, model/version qualification and jurisdiction-specific risk review before use.
